journeys.name: Open & activate a primary banking relationship

Mobile app sign-up, ID/KYC upload, branch assist, e-sign
App/web day-to-day use, card activation, contact centre, dispute resolution

Proactive financial-wellness nudges, attrition-risk outreach, service recovery
Referral prompts, reviews, community, advocacy programme

journeys.name: Onboard & grow an SME / corporate relationship

stages.touchpoints: RM prospecting, sector campaigns, events, LinkedIn/ABM, referrals
KYB/KYC, account opening, mandate capture, cash-management setup
RM servicing, digital business banking, merchant/payment enablement
Account triggers, lending applications, treasury cross-sell, sector insight
Renewal management, relationship reviews, churn-risk intervention
Case studies, referrals, sector community, co-marketing

journeys.name: Acquire & advise an affluent / HNW client

journeys.name: Grow an importer / exporter trade relationship

LC / guarantee request, document prep, issuance / advising, presentation
Working-capital expansion, supply-chain finance, transaction triggers
Renewal, discrepancy resolution, compliance escalation handling
Trade ecosystem references, partner co-marketing

capabilities.name: Strategy, brand & portfolio governance
capabilities.def: Define marketing strategy, brand architecture, segment priorities, value propositions, budgets, governance, and performance objectives.

capabilities.name: Market, customer & relationship insight
capabilities.def: Research markets, understand needs, segment customers, manage personas, identify life/business events, and produce customer/relationship insight.

capabilities.name: Proposition & offer management
capabilities.def: Translate products into customer-facing propositions, offers, bundles, pricing narratives, proof points, and RM/advisor enablement content.

capabilities.name: Campaign & journey orchestration
capabilities.def: Plan, execute, personalize, and optimize campaigns across digital, physical, social, events, RM, and partner channels; omnichannel success depends on integrated online/physical touchpoints and coherent end-to-end journeys.

capabilities.name: Lead, referral & sales enablement
capabilities.def: Manage lead capture, scoring, qualification, routing, next-best-action, pipeline handoff, and sales conversation support.

capabilities.name: Content, communications & reputation
capabilities.def: Manage messaging, thought leadership, financial education, internal communications, employee advocacy, public relations, events, sponsorships, and reputation.

capabilities.name: Data, MarTech, analytics & AI enablement
capabilities.def: Manage consented data use, marketing automation, customer 360, experimentation, attribution, dashboards, AI-assisted content/insight, and governed definitions.

capabilities.name: Risk, compliance & responsible marketing
capabilities.def: Apply conduct, privacy, AML/KYC, suitability, disclosure, accessibility, and evidence controls to campaigns and decisions.

capabilities.name: Marketing operations & partner management
capabilities.def: Manage briefs, workflow, resources, agencies, media, creative operations, SLAs, asset reuse, and delivery quality.

capabilities.name: Measurement, learning & optimization
capabilities.def: Close the loop from outcomes to insight, update segments/offers, manage KPI definitions, and prioritize improvement.

capabilities.name: Customer Experience Management
capabilities.def: Own experience strategy, standards and voice-of-customer, turning friction and complaint insight into measured experience improvement and service recovery.

capabilities.name: Journey Management
capabilities.def: Manage the journey portfolio: mapping, ownership, analytics, governance and optimisation of end-to-end customer journeys.

capabilities.name: Personalisation Management
capabilities.def: Select governed, context-aware treatments in real time: segmentation, propensity, next-best-action/offer, channel selection, contact policy, content personalisation and experimentation.

capabilities.name: CDP Management
capabilities.def: Operate the customer data platform as a governed data-product platform: identity, Customer 360, consent/preference, event ingestion, enrichment, activation and data quality/lineage.

capabilities.name: Customer Intelligence
capabilities.def: Generate insight from behaviour: pathing, cohort and attribution analysis and customer needs / jobs-to-be-done analytics.

capabilities.name: CLV Management
capabilities.def: Govern customer lifetime value: CLV model governance, customer profitability, retention and cross-sell economics, customer equity and value-based prioritisation.

capabilities.name: Feedback & Measurement
capabilities.def: Close the loop on experience: NPS/CSAT/CES, journey KPIs, closed-loop feedback, improvement backlog, benefit realisation and KPI-definition governance.

processes.name: Approve & activate campaign

processes.outputs: Approved campaign, channel deployment, RM packs
processes.participants: Marketing ops, agencies, digital, comms, RMs

processes.name: Capture, qualify & route demand
processes.inputs: Responses, event leads, digital signals, referrals
processes.outputs: Scored leads, RM tasks, nurturing journeys

processes.name: Convert, onboard & fulfil
processes.inputs: Qualified lead, customer intent, documents, eligibility

processes.name: Retain, deepen & advocate
processes.inputs: Usage, satisfaction, attrition signals, relationship data
processes.participants: RMs, service, wealth advisors, product, analytics

processes.name: Measure, learn & optimize
processes.inputs: Campaign, sales, CX, risk and cost data
processes.outputs: Performance report, decision learning, revised models

processes.name: Journey Design
processes.inputs: Persona, JTBD, stage & touchpoint definitions, pain/gain
processes.outputs: Journey map, moment-of-truth register, KPI map

processes.name: Personalisation Operations
processes.inputs: Targeting rules, treatment selection, content & channel rules
processes.outputs: Active journeys, NBA rules, contact policy

processes.name: Customer Insight Management
processes.outputs: Insight briefs, segment definitions, opportunity hypotheses

processes.name: CLV Optimisation

processes.name: Customer Feedback Management
processes.outputs: Driver analysis, action plan, closed loop

decisions.name: Segment & target selection
decisions.inputs: Segment value, eligibility, consent, propensity, risk flags
decisions.rules: Exclude non-consented customers; prioritize high-value needs

decisions.name: Value proposition selection
decisions.inputs: Segment needs, product fit, competitor position
decisions.rules: Message must state customer benefit, not only product feature

decisions.name: Campaign go/no-go & prioritisation
decisions.inputs: Budget, capacity, expected ROI, risk rating
decisions.rules: Launch only when owner, KPI, compliance approval and fulfilment capacity exist

decisions.name: Offer eligibility & suitability
decisions.rules: Do not present unsuitable or ineligible offers

decisions.name: Consent, privacy & data-use
decisions.inputs: Consent, purpose, data sensitivity, channel preference
decisions.rules: Use only approved data for approved purpose; provide opt-out

decisions.name: Channel & contact strategy
decisions.rules: Use preferred channel unless regulatory or service need overrides

decisions.name: Next-best-action
decisions.inputs: Relationship state, event trigger, propensity, service issues
decisions.rules: Service recovery may outrank sales offer

decisions.name: Lead scoring & routing
decisions.inputs: Lead source, intent, value, segment, geography, RM ownership
decisions.rules: Route high-value commercial/wealth leads to named RM/advisor

decisions.name: Content & disclosure approval
decisions.inputs: Claim, product terms, risk rating, audience
decisions.rules: Claims must be substantiated; required disclosures included

decisions.name: Measurement & optimization
decisions.inputs: KPI results, control group, cost, conversion, complaints
decisions.rules: Stop/adjust if lift is negative or risk complaints exceed threshold

decisions.name: Journey Prioritisation
decisions.inputs: CLV, NPS/CSAT/CES, complaint volume, drop-off, cost-to-serve
decisions.rules: Prioritise journeys with highest value-at-risk and worst experience

decisions.name: Journey Stage Treatment
decisions.inputs: Journey state, persona, product, behaviour, risk, consent
decisions.rules: Treatment must fit stage intent and consent basis

decisions.name: Next Best Action (extended)
decisions.inputs: Propensity, CLV, churn risk, eligibility, journey state
decisions.rules: Rank actions by value × eligibility × consent

decisions.name: Channel Selection
decisions.inputs: Preference, urgency, sensitivity, cost, consent, RM/advisor context
decisions.rules: Respect preference and sensitivity before cost

decisions.name: Customer Treatment Eligibility
decisions.inputs: Consent, risk, affordability, vulnerability, product eligibility
decisions.rules: Suppress if consent, vulnerability or eligibility fails

decisions.name: Retention Decision
decisions.inputs: Churn risk, complaint state, value, tenure, product usage
decisions.rules: High-value + high-churn enters priority retention path

decisions.name: CLV Optimisation
decisions.inputs: CLV forecast, cost, margin, retention uplift, expected response
decisions.rules: Invest where marginal CLV uplift exceeds cost

decisions.name: Human Review
decisions.inputs: Risk level, regulated advice, vulnerable customer, complaint, GenAI output
decisions.rules: Route high-risk / regulated / GenAI actions to human review

aiUseCases.name: Real-time next-best-action engine
aiUseCases.desc: Rank the best action (offer, service, nudge) per customer in real time from propensity, CLV, churn and journey state, enforcing consent and contact policy.

aiUseCases.name: Propensity-to-buy modelling
aiUseCases.desc: Score product propensity to prioritise cross-sell and target audiences with better fit and lower fatigue.

aiUseCases.name: Churn-risk prediction & save
aiUseCases.desc: Predict attrition early and trigger retention treatments, prioritised by value at risk.

aiUseCases.name: Customer lifetime value forecasting
aiUseCases.desc: Forecast CLV to steer acquisition quality, retention economics and value-based prioritisation.

aiUseCases.name: Hyper-personalised content & offers
aiUseCases.desc: Assemble message, offer and creative per customer and context, governed by consent, fairness and frequency caps.

aiUseCases.name: GenAI marketing copy & creative
aiUseCases.desc: Draft campaign copy, variants and creative at scale with human review, brand and disclosure controls.

aiUseCases.name: Campaign budget & mix optimisation
aiUseCases.desc: Allocate spend across channels and campaigns to maximise ROI / attributed revenue under constraints.

aiUseCases.name: Channel & send-time optimisation
aiUseCases.desc: Choose channel and timing per customer from preference, engagement history and cost.

aiUseCases.name: Lead scoring & intelligent routing
aiUseCases.desc: Score and route leads to the right RM/advisor with SLA, lifting conversion and RM productivity.

aiUseCases.name: Journey analytics & drop-off detection
aiUseCases.desc: Detect friction, drop-off and bottlenecks across journeys and feed the improvement backlog.

aiUseCases.name: Sentiment & voice-of-customer mining
aiUseCases.desc: Mine complaints, surveys and interactions for driver insight and emerging issues.

aiUseCases.name: ML-driven micro-segmentation
aiUseCases.desc: Cluster customers into behavioural micro-segments for sharper targeting and proposition design.

aiUseCases.name: Automated A/B & experiment engine
aiUseCases.desc: Design, run and read experiments continuously to prove lift before scaling.

aiUseCases.name: Next-best-conversation for RMs/advisors
aiUseCases.desc: Surface the right talking points and offers to RMs/advisors ahead of a client conversation.

aiUseCases.name: Consent & preference intelligence
aiUseCases.desc: Keep consent, purpose and preferences enforced across every treatment and channel, with audit.

aiUseCases.name: AI fairness & bias monitoring
aiUseCases.desc: Test marketing models for bias and monitor fairness, explainability and drift in production.

aiUseCases.name: Financial-wellness & proactive nudges
aiUseCases.desc: Detect life events and financial-wellness signals to serve helpful, non-sales nudges that build trust.

aiUseCases.name: Marketing attribution & ROI modelling
aiUseCases.desc: Attribute outcomes to marketing touches to prove contribution and reallocate to what works.
